task_types.ordinary_business: collection/alignment/source/transcript/data tasks that do not require real decoded-media inspection unless explicitly stated
task_types.real_playback: requires ffmpeg+ffprobe plus actual inspection of decoded clip/frame/audio and observed content position
task_types.gate_or_report: aggregate current P9/P10/gate/report work; once prerequisites are satisfied it does not itself require replaying media
task_types.admin_control: bug repair/control-plane/schema/CI/workflow maintenance; admin role only
task_types.legacy_record: immutable historical completion identity retained for audit only; never claim and never use as current acceptance evidence

notes: Existing valid claims remain owned by their current agents and are not migrated mid-task.
New claims must continue to the next eligible task unless a documented stop condition applies.
Only verified witnessGIT management-account Agents may fix bugs or modify the protected control plane; unknown identity defaults to worker.
Worker Agents execute claimed business tasks and submit bugs to coordination/bug_reports/; they do not repair project machinery.
A single GitHub create_file 422 or 409 must be classified against fresh repository state before it can become a write error.
If the exact claim exists after a failed create, classify CLAIM_RACE_LOST, refresh state, and try another eligible task immediately.
If a 409 leaves the exact claim absent, classify a moving-branch retry, refresh main, short-backoff, and retry against fresh state.
Only classify GITHUB_WRITE_ERROR when the exact claim remains absent after fresh bounded retries and no race/staleness/moving-main explanation applies.
External prompts should not duplicate project requirements; Agents must load them from the repository.
A minimal prompt containing only the repository address and an instruction to start work is sufficient.
Run scripts/project_status.py before classifying work state. Verified witnessGIT admin Agents use --role admin; all unknown/other identities remain worker.

The historical completed records P9-AUDIT-60 and P10-PILOT-DECISION predate the current playback-gated acceptance chain. Keep them for audit history, but never treat them as current completion or authorization.
The current acceptance tasks are P9-AUDIT-60-R2 and P10-PILOT-DECISION-R2.
The status classifier must evaluate ordinary business, gate/report, real-playback, and admin-control work separately.
Git provides durable coordination and resume state; it cannot revive a host-suspended ChatGPT/Work/Codex session.
An S-AUDIT completion or coordination/ready/audit marker does not by itself contribute a Pilot-60 playback check.

Real playback work is retryable and independent through scripts/playback_queue.py; blocked runtime attempts release the case for later retry instead of converting transcript checks into playback evidence.
A playback claim requires ffmpeg, ffprobe, and an explicit --content-inspection-capable declaration; a runtime that can run commands but cannot inspect decoded content must not claim a playback case.
Pilot-60 counts only canonical-crosschecked data/playback_audits records created after successful real-media decode plus actual content inspection with observed position and timing error.
Successful decode without content inspection contributes zero qualifying playback checks.
Playback decode windows must include time before and after the expected timestamp so both negative and positive signed timing errors can be measured.
P9-AUDIT-60-R2 remains blocked until scripts/audit_gate.py passes and scripts/playback_queue.py --seal-gate creates P9-PLAYBACK-GATE.
If Pilot-60 already passes, remaining extra playback cases do not create HOST_STOP for the acceptance path; seal P9-PLAYBACK-GATE and continue with current P9/P10.
Current P9/P10 are gate/report tasks. They do not require the executing Agent to replay media once their prerequisites have been satisfied.
An admin Agent must not report HOST_STOP merely because playback is unavailable when open admin bug reports or other compatible non-playback work remain.
P10-PILOT-DECISION-R2 remains blocked until P9-AUDIT-60-R2 completes.
A completed current P10 record does not authorize FULL_ARCHIVE unless it contains full_archive_decision=YES. full_archive_decision=NO, a missing field, or an invalid value keeps FULL_ARCHIVE locked.

If ordinary/gate/admin-compatible work is empty but unclaimed playback work remains below the Pilot-60 threshold, a non-media runtime may classify only its own session as HOST_STOP; repository-wide NO_ELIGIBLE_WORK remains false.

Missing shell/media execution or inability to inspect generated clips is HOST_STOP/runtime capability limitation; SAFETY_OR_ACCESS_BLOCK is reserved for access that would require bypassing login, CAPTCHA, paywall, DRM, or other controls.
Backlog documentation or collection/export tooling may be completed when independently claimable, but cannot substitute for playback evidence and cannot unlock current P9/P10/FULL_ARCHIVE.
